referenceLabelDisputes.effect: Primary frozen-label scores remain unchanged. Also report a sensitivity count excluding these disputed negative cases, without treating that as a new blind evaluation.
referenceLabelDisputes.reviewer: Assistant direct visual review, not independent expert adjudication.

cases.reason: At full size the displayed boots have substantial lighter worn areas. Soil, scuffing and coating loss cannot be confidently separated; the initial negative label was too strong.
Full-size glove piping shows rough/fuzzy edges. Normal raw trim versus wear-related fraying is not confidently separable.
The vintage leather coat has finish variation and edge wear. Patina, reflections and coating loss are not reliably separable, so a strict negative label is debatable.
